description: This Python source file defines functions and data for seeding role and skill data into a database for a career navigation platform. It includes a private function to generate seed data, and a public function to populate the database with roles, skills, and their mappings, ensuring idempotency.

methods.name: Dict[str,Dict[str,int]] _get_role_seed_data()
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping roles to their required skills and levels, with a predefined set of common and role-specific skills.

methods.name: None seed_roles_and_skills(db: Session)
methods.description: Seeds the database with role and skill data, creating skills, roles, and role-skill mappings if they do not already exist, in an idempotent manner.
